visual: Compact deciduous shrub with aromatic grey-green foliage and dark reddish stems, producing dense clusters of rich deep blue-purple flowers in late summer and early autumn.
soil: Chalk, loam or sand; moderately fertile and well-drained
soilWarning: Avoid heavy, poorly drained or winter-wet soils. A warm sheltered position gives the best flowering and survival.
prune: Pruning group 6; cut back hard in spring to a low woody framework to encourage strong new flowering growth.
hardinessNote: Fully hardy in much of the UK, though a warm sheltered position is preferable in colder areas.
resilience: Drought tolerant once established and well suited to hot, sunny positions; dislikes winter waterlogging.
uses: Flower borders, wildlife gardens, cottage gardens, Mediterranean-style planting, gravel gardens and containers.
foliage: Deciduous; aromatic grey-green leaves with silvery undersides.
container: Suitable for a large container with excellent drainage.
